text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Man, it's really summer, ain't it?
choice_data_list: It's summer, huh~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure is hot, huh~
choice_data_list: Well, it is summer~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahhh...
choice_data_list: Are you bored or something?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good grief.
To think that Sei-chan of all people
would have her mind read so easily.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from reading your mind, it was written all over you...
In short, you were telling me how bored you were, right?
choice_data_list: Wanna go fishing?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Summer means the beach, and the beach means fishing.
Is that kinda... the impression you have of Sei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
I'm just not really feelin' it though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —From what I hear, everywhere's been crowded lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are some hidden gems, but lately even those
places have seen more tourists and gotten
pretty lively, or so I've heard.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, spending time in the usual place and having our usual lively fun isn't bad at all, though~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "As for Sei-chan, occasionally getting away from the hustle and bustle and enjoying a summer different from the usual sounds pretty nice, y'know?"
choice_data_list: A summer that's different from usual, huh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that kind of thing feel... kinda special?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "I thought it'd be nice every once in a while~ but is it too difficult, nya~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A special feeling... a summer unlike any other.
Indeed, under those conditions,
it'd be tough without a really exceptional place."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it wouldn't hurt to keep looking without giving up.
After searching through various options, we decided to head out together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, there's really nobody here at all.
And it's so quiet... well, maybe not quite.
choice_data_list: I can hear insects I've never heard before...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right... There are multiple voices, and it's hard to make out each one, but...
there's some strange voices too...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......
...Ahh...
Listening to the bugs is making me sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh. There's shade under the trees over there,
so maybe we can take a nap.
choice_data_list: That looks nice and cool... Just a little...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just a little, pretty please~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was a good sleep.
I'm sweating a bit, but hey,
it is summer after all.
choice_data_list: Shall we go cool off for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Indeed~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, a refreshing breeze and the scent of pasture grass... Summer's really here.
choice_data_list: They had soft serve!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice find.
Just water wasn't really cutting it for me~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what'll you have?
Sei-chan might go with watermelon milk~
It looks like a summer exclusive."
choice_data_list: I wonder if that's summer mandarin milk?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That sounds good too~
Let's trade and have a taste.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could we get one of each
of the summer flavor soft-serves, please~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's so humid.
...Wait, where even are we??
choice_data_list: I wonder where...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~...
Wasn't this the place you chose, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I must have dozed off on the train... and ended up... here...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you're just as guilty, Sei-chan!
I was having such a nice dream, too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's really nothing here at all~
I guess we're done here.
Time to head back... huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There was a cat over there just now!
A huge one, like nothing I've ever seen before!
choice_data_list: Like a wildcat? Isn't that dangerous?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-san.
Go on ahead.
choice_data_list: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —In the end, we never found the big cat. Drenched in sweat from the humidity, where we finally ended up was—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Summer really is all about the beach, huh.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I guess so...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"What were we wandering around for
today again...?"
choice_data_list: It feels like... a special summer, or something...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh right, that's how it was.
...Wait, what I ended up doing
wasn't any different from usual!"
choice_data_list: It wasn't a particularly special summer, was it...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, I just threw out a comeback on impulse, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"This is fine in its own way,
wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We went to places we don't usually go,
so in a way, that felt kind of "special" too, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, you looked like you were having
plenty of fun yourself, Trainer, meow~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...True enough. I carried on without really understanding what a 'special summer' was supposed to be... but it certainly wasn't boring."
choice_data_list: That was definitely good exercise!
Still, I'd love to search for a "special summer" again someday.
Maybe that was a good experience?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, Sei-chan's gonna
get even stronger again~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. Trainer, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Still full of motivation, aren't we?
Though that might have to wait until next year, meow~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. Trainer, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it. Even if it wasn't particularly extraordinary,
it was still a summer a little different from the usual.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. Trainer, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sound of fireworks echoes in the distance. Listening closely, lively voices of the crowd can also be heard. Looking carefully, fireworks were rising far, far away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Not quite a clamor,
nor is it quiet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My, oh my, what a pleasantly mild summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though we didn't find a "special summer,"
we discovered a "just-right summer"
that felt just a little bit different from the usual.
